test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of the base of a cone is 616 cm². If its slant height is 20 cm, then what is the total surface area of the cone? [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
**Given:**

Area of base of cone = 616 cm²

Slant height = 20 cm

**Concept Used:**

TSA of cone = pi r²+pi rl

**Calculation:**

Area of base of cone = pi r²

⇒ (22)/(7) × r² = 616

⇒ r² = (616times 7)/(22) = 28 × 7 = 196

⇒ r = sqrt{196} = 14 cm

TSA of cone = 616 + (22)/(7) × 14 × 20

⇒ TSA of cone = 616 + 44 × 20 = 616 + 880 = 1496 cm²

**Therefore, the total surface area of the cone is 1496 cm².**
